name: Sylvania (United States)
description: White field with a diagonal stripe of green and blue rising to the fly, charged with a white disc outlined in blue bearing a green maple leaf, with City of and Sylvania in blue.
history: Sylvania is a city in Lucas County, Ohio, adjoining Toledo. Flags of the World records that this flag was replaced around 2021 by one bearing the city's new burr-oak-leaf logo, approved by city council in 2020 and introduced on flags by July 2021 according to the mayor's message.
